_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::thermal#7. One HEX8 SOLIDSCATRA cube, symmetry-constrained on three faces, no thermal boundary condition, INITTEMP 293, THEXPANS 1.2e-05, L=1. Two decks differing only in whether THERMAL DYNAMIC carries INITIALFIELD: "field_by_function" + INITFUNCNO: 1 (FUNCT1 = 293.0). With it, T = 293 = INITTEMP and dispx at node 2 is 0 — unstrained, exit 0. Without it the temperature is exactly 0.00000000000000000e+00, not INITTEMP, and the cube contracts by actresult=-3.51599999999999959e-03 = alpha*(0-293)*L at t=0. There is no diagnostic either way (INITIALFIELD_DIAGNOSTIC=0) and the deck still reaches the result test, so the only detector is a RESULT DESCRIPTION entry pinning the initial state. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: temp     at node   7	 is WRONG --> actresult= 0.00000000000000000e+00
dispx    at node   2	 is WRONG --> actresult=-3.51599999999999959e-03

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the second deck the same INITIALFIELD lines. Its temperature is then 293 = INITTEMP, dispx is 0, EXIT_WITHOUT_INITIALFIELD becomes 0 and both WRONG lines disappear, so the fixture must go red.
